description: Intake status of every tracked programme in one country at once: open, paused or closed, the last selection round and cutoff, what is expected next, the official source and the date it was last read. Routes with continuous intake are counted, not listed. Use it before recommending anything in that country.

country.description: Lowercase destination country code, e.g. 'de', 'ca' or 'uk'. 'gb' also works for the UK.

name: transita_list_programmes
title: List programme statuses
